auth_methods_evidence: WooCommerce REST API uses Basic Auth with consumer key/secret pair. Nango lists BASIC, which is correct — the consumer key acts as an API key sent via Basic auth. https://woocommerce.com/document/woocommerce-rest-api/
self_serve_evidence: To create or manage keys for a specific WordPress user: 1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API. 2. Select Create an API key or Add Key.
buildability_rationale: Self-serve API key authentication with good documentation and broad API surface, though no official OpenAPI spec.
agent_notes: The documentation provides clear instructions for API key generation and management, but doesn't specify the exact number of endpoints available. [NANGO CROSS-CHECK: Nango lists BASIC. Updated to include both api_key and basic — WooCommerce uses Basic auth with consumer key/secret.]
